resources.string: Shows a small floating control over Exponential Idle. When you press Start it reads the 15-Puzzle minigame (the tile numbers Exponential Idle shows, or a screenshot if needed), solves it, and taps the tiles for you. It looks at which windows are on screen (where they are, not what they say) so it pauses whenever a call, dialog, notification shade or other app covers the puzzle, and resumes when it is clear.
